description: F7 rule 2 golden: iap.execution.sor_v2.CostAwareRouter passive routing with fill probability (API_TRADING.md section 2.9 / 2.13 P0-4): passive_costs / route_passive with the model's p_fill_touch or with hazard_fill_prob(rate, horizon_s) where rate(vid, side, q) reads the per-venue calibration document (`calibration_docs`, keyed by venue id; `source` exec = queue_exec_depletion_hazard (X-4), pooled = queue_depletion_hazard, cancel = queue_cancel_depletion_hazard; a venue without a document or an empty cell is None and skipped); aggressive_costs / route_aggressive; allocate_passive. Costs are keyed by venue id as strings; route 0 = NO_ROUTE; {error} = ValueError. Books and ledger fills as in expected_f7_sor_sweep.json.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

slice.rule: a sample is taken after applying the k-th event (1-based) whenever k > prefix_events and k % sample_every == 0
slice.queries: at every sample, in order: passive buy / sell (model p_fill), passive buy with latency penalty 0.5 bps/ms + miss 1.25 bps + 100ms toxicity and the exec hazard fill_prob at 1 s, passive sell with the exec hazard at 5 s, aggressive buy, aggressive sell (penalty options), allocate buy 1050 (lot 100, tox cap 1.0, scale 0.5), allocate sell 777 (lot 1, scale 2.0); ts = the sampled event's exchange_ts; the hazard tables are `calibration_docs["101"]`
